headlines.title: Key Primary Results: Florida, California, Wyoming, Alaska
headlines.description: Florida delivered the biggest surprise of the primaries on Tuesday when Democratic Socialist Angie Nixon scored an upset victory in the senate race. NBC’s Ryan Nobles reports for TODAY on all the results and how they’ll impact on the buildup to November’s midterm elections.

headlines.title: Democratic socialist will face Republican rival in Florida after Senate primary upset
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Nixon, a state lawmaker, will face GOP Sen. Ashley Moody, who was appointed to replace Secretary of State Marco Rubio, in the general election.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola advance to battleground Senate election in Alaska
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Sullivan and Peltola will advance to the general election, but it’s not clear whether Sullivan will also face an opponent with the same name.

headlines.title: Telemundo executive among 7 killed in Kenya helicopter crash
headlines.description: Five Americans are dead following a helicopter crash in a remote area of northern Kenya, the U.S.

headlines.title: Trump admin was warned about peeling Reflecting Pool before it brought vandalism case
headlines.description: A National Park Service engineer warned the Trump administration about the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool peeling in early June due to the renovation issues.

headlines.title: China’s backflipping robots leap to blockbuster stock market debut in latest sign of AI boom
headlines.description: Unitree, China’s humanoid robotics firm, saw its shares soar 460% on its Shanghai stock market debut on Wednesday, as investors rally behind homegrown beneficiaries of the A.I. boom.

headlines.title: Merck and Moderna say cancer vaccine shows signs of preventing recurrence of melanoma
headlines.description: Pharmaceutical giants Moderna and Merck said that an experimental vaccine treatment has shown signs of preventing cancer from returning or spreading in a study of high-risk melanoma patients. NBC News health reporter Aria Bendix explains what happens next.

headlines.title: Book him: Prosecutors using James Comey’s novel against him in seashells case
headlines.description: Federal prosecutors want to throw the book at former FBI Director James Comey in their seashells-based case — including his own crime novel.

headlines.description: A National Park Service engineer warned the Trump administration about the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool peeling in early June due to the renovation issues.

headlines.title: Family of woman missing in Las Vegas says they have received strange Bitcoin demands
headlines.description: The family of a 63-year-old woman who disappeared in Las Vegas earlier this month while visiting a friend says someone posing as the woman has been calling and texting from her phone, demanding payment in Bitcoin.

headlines.title: Trump says he will meet with Kim Jong Un this year
headlines.description: President Donald Trump confirmed to reporters that he plans to meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un this year, a highly unusual move for an American president, if not for Trump himself.
